newsitem.title: GERMANY: Jittery German DAX ends bourse trade down 2.44 pct.
newsitem.headline: Jittery German DAX ends bourse trade down 2.44 pct.

text.p: 1145 GMT - German shares take a tumble during floor trade in Frankfurt on Friday, falling nearly two and a half percent after a big sell-off. Lower Bunds cited as factor and dealers say uncertainty in the wake of Waigel/Bundesbank clash on valuation of gold assets and jitters before French election on Sunday dampen sentiment.
* DAX-30 ends at 3,547.84 points, down 88.58 or 2.44 pct.
* June DAX future at 3,557.5 points, down 80.5 points. Dealers say derivatives a big factor in today's sell-off.
* Market now looking ahead to opening prices on Wall Street for direction, traders say.
